categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Jinfu Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two sectors: consumer electronics and new energy. Its main products include LCD display modules and complete machines, consumer electronic components, testing fixtures and automation equipment, lithium battery components, automotive parts, petroleum resin products, and power equipment maintenance and installation engineering. The company also engages in chemical materials and other related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies such as optical design, mold development, injection molding, and structural design for LCD modules. It employs precision mechanical, servo control, and machine vision technologies in its intelligent testing and automation equipment. In new energy, it utilizes patented aerogel packaging technologies and advanced cutting processes for thermal insulation products, and develops integrated CCS modules with patented structures. The company also focuses on graphene heating films and high-performance bonding materials, emphasizing automation and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international consumer electronics firms such as Apple, TCL Huaxing Optoelectronics, LGD, Hikvision, BOE, Hisense, Luxshare Precision, Lianchuang Optoelectronics, and Sunny Optical. In the new energy sector, major clients include CATL, Minth Group, and Geely. The company serves industries including consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, lithium batteries, power engineering, and chemical materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production and R&D bases in the Yangtze River Delta (Shanghai, Suzhou, Taizhou), Pearl River Delta (Shenzhen, Dongguan, Changsha), Bohai Rim Economic Zone (Weihai), and Haixi Economic Zone (Xiamen). It also has international presence with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Vietnam, serving markets in Southeast Asia and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Jinfu Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures key components such as LCD modules, battery packs, and automotive parts, and provides testing and automation equipment, as well as power equipment maintenance services. The company integrates R&D and manufacturing, supplying components and assemblies to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a dual-driven strategy focusing on consumer electronics and new energy industries, emphasizing development in thermal management materials, high-end bonding materials, and electrochemical materials. It invests heavily in R&D for intelligent testing equipment, flexible PCB testing, smart display terminals, graphene heat dissipation films, and advanced battery materials. The company also prioritizes talent acquisition, innovation platforms, and collaboration with key customers and academic institutions to enhance technological capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of LCD modules, consumer electronic components, lithium battery parts, automotive parts, and power engineering services. The company also earns income from testing and automation equipment sales and related technical services. It conducts direct sales mainly within China, with a smaller portion from exports. Other income sources include government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major players in consumer electronics components and new energy sectors, including TCL Huaxing Optoelectronics, Hikvision, CATL, Minth Group, and Geely. It positions itself as a comprehensive R&D and manufacturing service provider with integrated capabilities in advanced materials and intelligent manufacturing, aiming to strengthen its market share through technological innovation and strategic customer partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.74 billion, a 24.32% increase from 2022. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 224 million, slightly improved from the previous year. Total assets grew by 37.97% to RMB 3.93 billion, and net assets increased by 82.58% to RMB 1.16 billion. The company completed a private placement raising RMB 738 million to support strategic projects, indicating ongoing investment in growth and transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suzhou Jinfu Technology emphasizes its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, advanced production technologies, and strong industry experience. Its product differentiation lies in high-quality, cost-effective components with innovative features such as graphene-based thermal management and patented aerogel insulation. The company offers customized intelligent testing solutions and comprehensive services, supported by a broad customer base and strategic partnerships, aiming to deliver superior product performance and reliability in consumer electronics and new energy markets.
